observation.command:
cd /tmp
# Get CSRF token + cookie jar from sign-in page
curl -sS -c /tmp/cj.txt -o /tmp/signin.html http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in
TOKEN=$(grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/signin.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"
# POST login
curl -sS -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -L -o /tmp/login.html -w "FINAL_URL=%{url_effective} HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}\n" \
  -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in \
  -d "authenticity_token=$(python3 -c 'import urllib.parse,sys; print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.argv[1]))' "$TOKEN")" \
  -d "user[email]=admin@example.org" \
  -d "user[password]=TTOF3UHA0bsQ"
echo "=== resulting page title ==="
grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/login.html 2>/dev/null || true
head -3 /tmp/login.html 2>/dev/null
